sources.title: GitHub - UdgamLabs/chitra-tiny: Chitra Tiny: a 212M-parameter text-to ...
sources.snippet: A 212M-parameter English text-to-image model that makes 256×256 pictures from a sentence. Built by Udgam Labs, a frontier technology lab. The image model was trained from scratch, on about 4.7 million public-domain and CC0 images. It runs on a laptop: about 3 seconds per image on an Apple-silicon Mac. Chitra (चित्र) means "picture".

sources.snippet: Supported by a robust community of partners, ONNX defines a common set of operators and a common file format to enable AI developers to use models with a variety of frameworks, tools, runtimes, and compilers. This repository is a curated collection of pre-trained, state-of-the-art models in the ONNX format.
